# An empty whatIf is rejected outright

**Claim.** `?whatIf=` is the one value that neither simulates nor merges: it is refused with a bare BAD_REQUEST. Every other non-empty value performs the merge, so the empty string is the only typo here that is safe.

Applies to: `~1people~1{vanId}~1mergeInto/put`

## Observed exchange

```http
(setup) POST /people/create

{
  "firstName": "Dana",
  "lastName": "Whitfield-{scope}"
}

→ 201
  Location: https://api.securevan.com/v4/people/100000001
{
  "vanId": 100000001,
  "status": "Stored"
}
```
```http
(setup) POST /people/create

{
  "firstName": "Dana",
  "lastName": "Whitfield-{scope}"
}

→ 201
  Location: https://api.securevan.com/v4/people/100000002
{
  "vanId": 100000002,
  "status": "Stored"
}
```

_Send the parameter with no value. Nothing is merged and nothing is simulated._

```http
PUT /people/100000002/mergeInto?whatIf=

{
  "vanId": 100000001
}

→ 400
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "BAD_REQUEST",
      "text": "The request is invalid."
    }
  ]
}
```

_Both records survive, confirming the request was refused before anything was written._
